name: 検索語に一致した資料の分類一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse catalog component LH15-0007: sorted search-result document list with four rows, no full page/device.
Hierarchy: Image1 ORIGINAL controls glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, icon alignment, spacing and fine controls. Use its sort bar and four search-result rows only, source x47 y422 w1097 h975. Preserve original downward SORT ARROW WITH SHAFT, compact 3x3 grid-view glyph at far right, four horizontal overflow controls. Preserve row file-type artwork: yellow presentation/slides, blue document, purple video/play, green spreadsheet. Preserve the gray favorite star immediately before row3 metadata; mock wrongly omits it. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary for exact Japanese content and selected four rows; replace rough generic green blank-page icons, open V sort chevron, malformed grid geometry and omitted star using original. Image3 approved bus only white surface, gentle elevation and restrained brand styling.
Text exactly:
top "関連度順"
row1 "会議の発表資料" / "更新 5:01"
row2 "会議の記録" / "更新 5:09"
row3 "会議の映像資料" / "更新 5:02"
row4 "作業の確認表" / "更新 5:01"
Meiryo Regular14/24px title, Regular12/16px metadata and sort label, tracking0. Preserve complete Japanese and numerals, no oversized bold headings.
Compact logical width390px. Top label and original sort arrow left, grid at far right. Four vertically aligned two-line rows with type icon left and three dots right; gray star before row3 metadata only. No other extra icons/rows.
Pure#FFFFFF canvas and one white rounded group surface, fine neutral outline, soft small downward shadow, no nested row cards. Main ink#1D1D1D, metadata#6E6E6E, utility grid/star/dots#526173. Original file-type yellow/blue/purple/green are preserved artwork and have consistent meaning, not decorative random accents. Adapt sort direction indicator's blue to forest-green#1F6444 arrow in small white outlined circle; this communicates current ordering. No broad tint, mint, gloss or glow. No CTA exists; invent no button or metric.
Original details override mock; preserve file-type artwork. No source search/filter/navigation chrome, English copy, watermark, IDs, captions or new content.
reviewNotes: 原図と自作を開いて比較し原図の細部を優先：4種類の資料形式、3行目のスター、軸付き下向きソート矢印、右側グリッド、各行三点を復元。生成を目視：4件の日本語題名・時刻と操作を保持。色は形式の原アート、ソート方向のみブランド緑、通常操作スレート。厳密なフォントメトリクスとグリッドの細かなピクセル照合は未証明。所有者承認・編集性・実装未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
